preconditions.description: The number of settlements n, affected settlements m, and damage range d must satisfy 1 ≤ m ≤ n ≤ 100000.
The damage range d must satisfy 0 ≤ d ≤ n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= n for p in p_list)
preconditions.description: Each affected settlement p in the list p1, p2, ..., pm must be between 1 and n.
The list of affected settlements p1, p2, ..., pm must contain distinct values.
The number of paths (edges) must be exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each path (edge) must connect two settlements between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output is the count of settlements that could contain the Book of Evil, where each candidate settlement s satisfies: all affected settlements p are at distance ≤ d from s, and there exists at least one affected settlement p at distance ≤ d from s.
